name: Logs
description: Google Cloud Logging Logs based dashboards.

children.name: GKE - Cluster Logs
children.description: The GKE - Cluster Logs - dashboard provides a high-level view of the overall health of the clusters, along with details on all the components and resources.
children.title: GKE - Cluster Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| timeslice 1h
| count as events by _timeslice, cluster, project
| transpose row _timeslice column cluster, project

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource severity "\"kind\":\"Event\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.severity" as labels, severity
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| if (severity in ("WARNING", "ALERT", "CRITICAL", "FATAL", "EMERGENCY"), 1, 0) as error
| timeslice 1h
| count as events, sum(error) as errors by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift 1d 7 avg
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload.source.host", "message.data.severity" as labels, node, severity
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| if (severity in ("ERROR","WARNING", "ALERT", "CRITICAL", "FATAL", "EMERGENCY"), 1, 0) as error
| count as events, sum(error) as errors by node
| errors / events as error_pct
| sort by events

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "reason"
| timeslice 1h
| count as events by _timeslice, reason
| transpose row _timeslice column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource type severity timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type", "message.data.timestamp" as type, timestamp
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "involvedObject.kind", "involvedObject.name" as message, kind, name
| concat(kind, "::", name) as involved_object
| count as events by timestamp, message, involved_object, cluster
| sort by timestamp

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName source reason 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload.reason", "message.data.jsonPayload.source.host" as labels, reason,node
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| count as events by reason, node, project
| transpose row node, project column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*
| json "message.data" as data
// match resource type and logname
| json field= data "resource.type" as type  
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
// extract info and compare severity
| json field=data "severity", "resource.labels.cluster_name", "resource.labels" as severity, cluster, labels
| where severity = "ERROR" or severity = "WARNING" or severity = "CRITICAL" or severity = "EMERGENCY" or severity = "ALERT"
// extract from labels the field project
| json field=labels "project_id" as project
// every min
| timeslice 1m
// display the count of 1min timeslices agianst severity messages 
| count by _timeslice, severity
| fillmissing timeslice(1m), values("ERROR", "WARNING", "CRITICAL", "EMERGENCY", "ALERT") in severity
| transpose row _timeslice column severity as *

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*
| json "message.data" as data
//check the type and logname to match 
| json field=data "resource.type" as type  
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
// extract data project name cluster name label and severity to be used 
| json field=data "resource.labels.project_id", "resource.labels.cluster_name", "resource.labels.", "severity", "jsonPayload.source.host" as project, cluster, labels, severity,node
| where severity = "ERROR" or severity = "WARNING" or severity = "CRITICAL" or severity = "EMERGENCY" or severity = "ALERT"
// count the total severity occurances by project 
| count by node, severity  
| transpose row node column severity

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource Scaled
| json field=_raw "message.data.jsonPayload.message", "message.data.severity"  as log, severity
| where severity = "INFO"
| parse field=log "Scaled * replica set * to *" as direction,replica_set,size
| where direction = "up" 
| count as scale_ups by replica_set, size

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource Scaled
| json field=_raw "message.data.jsonPayload.message", "message.data.severity"  as log, severity
| where severity = "INFO"
| parse field=log "Scaled * replica set * to *" as direction,replica_set,size
| where direction = "down"
//| where size = 0
| count as scale_downs by replica_set, size

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* error
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| json field=_raw "message.data.jsonPayload.message", "message.data.resource.labels","message.data.timestamp"  as message, labels, timestamp
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| count by timestamp, project, cluster,log_name, message

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource severity "\"kind\":\"Event\""
| json "message.data.severity" as severity
| timeslice 1h
| count _timeslice, severity 
| transpose row _timeslice column severity
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*  error
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.severity", "message.data.jsonPayload.message", "message.data.timestamp" as labels, severity, message, timestamp 
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name", "node_name" as project, cluster, node
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/kube-proxy"

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*  error
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.severity", "message.data.jsonPayload.message", "message.data.timestamp" as labels, severity, message, timestamp
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name", "node_name" as project, cluster, node
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/kube-proxy"
| count by timestamp,node,severity,message

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* error
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| json field=_raw "message.data.jsonPayload.MESSAGE", "message.data.jsonPayload.PRIORITY","message.data.resource.labels.cluster_name", "message.data.resource.labels.project_id"  , "message.data.timestamp","message.data.resource.labels.node_name" as message, priority, cluster, project, timestamp, node
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/kubelet"
| count by node

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* error
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| json field=_raw "message.data.jsonPayload.MESSAGE", "message.data.jsonPayload.PRIORITY","message.data.resource.labels.cluster_name", "message.data.resource.labels.project_id"  , "message.data.timestamp","message.data.resource.labels.node_name" as message, priority, cluster, project, timestamp, node
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/kubelet"
| count by timestamp,node,priority,message

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource severity "\"kind\":\"Event\""
| json "message.data.severity" as severity
| count by severity

| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.severity" as labels, severity
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| where cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, severity

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName resource Scaled
| json field=_raw "message.data.jsonPayload.message" as log
| json field=_raw "message.data.severity" as severity
| where severity = "INFO"
| parse field=log "Scaled * replica set * to *" as direction,replica_set,scaled_to

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* "Deleted pod"

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* "Created pod"

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* error
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| json field=_raw "message.data.jsonPayload.message" as message

| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster

children.name: GKE - K8s Audit Logs
children.description: The GKE - K8s Audit Logs dashboard provides security-relevant logs documenting the sequence of activities that have affected system by individual users, administrators or other components of the system.
children.title: GKE - K8s Audit Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* 
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| parse regex "\"methodName\":\"(?<methodName>[^\"]+)\"" 
| parse regex "\"principalEmail\":\"(?<principalEmail>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "*activity*" and type="k8s_cluster" and !(principalEmail matches "*system*") and (methodName matches "*io.k8s.authorization.rbac.v1*")

panels.title: Top Users and System Components by Pod Requests
panels.visualSettings: {"general":{"mode":"distribution","type":"pie"},"title":{"fontSize":"Top Users and System Components by Pod Requests"},"legend":{"enabled":false}}

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* "io.k8s.core.v1.pods"
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| parse regex "\"methodName\":\"(?<methodName>[^\"]+)\"" 
| parse regex "\"principalEmail\":\"(?<user>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "*activity*" and type="k8s_cluster" and methodName matches "io.k8s.core.v1.pods*"
| count by user

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* 
| json field=_raw "message.data.resource.type", "message.data.protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail","message.data.protoPayload.request.metadata.name", "message.data.protoPayload.request.metadata.namespace", "message.data.resource.labels.cluster_name", "message.data.logName","message.data.protoPayload.methodName", "message.data.protoPayload.request.kind" as type, created_by, name, namespace, cluster, log_name, methodName,  component
| json field=_raw "message.data.protoPayload.request.spec.replicas" as replicas nodrop
| where log_name matches "*activity*" and type="k8s_cluster" and methodName matches "*create*"
| count by component, name, namespace, cluster, created_by, replicas

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* 
| json field=_raw "message.data.resource.type", "message.data.protoPayload.response.metadata.name", "message.data.logName", "message.data.protoPayload.methodName" as type,name, log_name, methodName 
| json field=_raw "message.data.protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail", "message.data.protoPayload.response.metadata.namespace", "message.data.protoPayload.response.kind", "message.data.resource.labels.cluster_name"  as modified_by, namespace, component, cluster nodrop
| where log_name matches "*activity*" and type="k8s_cluster" and (methodName matches "*delete*" or methodName matches "*update*" )
| if( methodName matches "*delete*", "Delete", "Update") as action
| count by component, name, namespace, cluster, action, modified_by

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* 
| json field=_raw "message.data.protoPayload.request.kind" as kind | count by kind | sort by _count asc

children.name: GKE - Node Logs
children.description: The GKE - Node Logs - dashboard displays information on the overall health of the nodes, along with highlights on errors, warnings, and unusual conditions.
children.title: GKE - Node Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName source host 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload.source.host" as labels, node
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| timeslice 1h 
| count by _timeslice, node, cluster, project
| transpose row _timeslice column node, cluster, project
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName source host 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "reason", "source.host" as reason, node
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| count as events by reason, node, cluster, project
| transpose row node, cluster, project column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName reason host 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload", "message.data.severity" as labels, payload, severity
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "reason", "source.host" as reason, node
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| if (severity in ("ERROR","WARNING", "ALERT", "CRITICAL", "FATAL", "EMERGENCY"), 1, 0) as error
| count as events, sum(error) as errors by node, cluster, project
| errors / events as error_pct
| sort by events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName "\"reason\":\"Scheduled\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| parse regex "\"message\":\"[^\"]* assigned (?<pod>[^\" ]+) to (?<node>[^\" ]+)"
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| timeslice 1h 
| count as eventCount by _timeslice, node, cluster, project
| transpose row _timeslice column node, cluster, project

| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.timestamp", "message.data.jsonPayload.message" as labels, timestamp, message
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
//| parse regex "\"message\":\"[^\"]* assigned (?<pod>[^\" ]+) to (?<node>[^\" ]+)"
| parse regex field=message "[^\"]* assigned (?<pod>[^\" ]+) to (?<node>[^\" ]+)"
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| count as events by timestamp, message, pod, node, cluster, project
| sort by timestamp asc
| 1 as event
| accum event as scheduled by node, cluster, project
| fields timestamp, message, pod, node, cluster, project, scheduled
| sort by timestamp

children.name: GKE - Pod Logs
children.description: The GKE - Pod Logs - dashboard displays information on the overall health of the pods, along with details on the resources being utilized, errors, warnings, and unusual conditions.
children.title: GKE - Pod Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName resource severity timestamp type
| json "message.data.resource.type", "message.data.severity", "message.data.timestamp" as type, severity, timestamp
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "involvedObject.kind", "involvedObject.name" as message, kind, pod
| where kind="Pod" or message matches "*pod*"
| where pod matches "{{pod}}" and cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
| count as events by timestamp, severity, message, pod, cluster
| sort by timestamp

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*  jsonPayload logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "reason", "involvedObject.name" as message, reason, pod
| where pod matches "{{pod}}" and cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
//| where (message matches "*Container*" or message matches "*container*")
| timeslice 1h
| count as events by _timeslice, reason
| transpose row _timeslice column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*  jsonPayload logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "reason", "involvedObject.name" as message, reason, pod
| where (message matches "*pod*" or message matches "*Pod*") //and (reason="SuccessfulCreate" or reason="SuccessfulDelete")
| where pod matches "{{pod}}" and cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
| timeslice 1h
| count as events by _timeslice, reason
| transpose row _timeslice column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "k8s_pod" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
